dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Every time I think that such a thing happened to us, I grow very afraid...

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: (If I were to be captured by Stormterror, Master Diluc would definitely come to my rescue...)

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: (This... This must be the part where the dashing prince saves the kidnapped princess!)

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: (Then... maybe our story will be written about in fairy tales... No, wait, why am I thinking about something like that now?)

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Wh—Whatever it is, it was too terrifying for me. Oh, Lord Barbatos, please protect Mondstadt...
